PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MARCH 14, 2019
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Administration of Oath to Newly Appointed Planning Commissioner V. Jesse Smith
4. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Avery, Smith and Ward
5. Selection of Planning Commission Chair and Vice Chair
6. Review of Agenda
7. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
8. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
9. Consent Calendar
9A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of January 10, 2019.
9A
10. Public Hearings
10A. Conditional Use Permit 18-004
A request to establish a Type 41 (On-Sale Beer and Wine) Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License to sell
beer and wine at the Cinemark Theater located at 1475 West Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-014 approving Conditional Use Permit 18-004 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
10A
10B. Conditional Use Permit 18-015
Sales Plus, Applicant
A request to establish an amusement arcade use within a 1,100 square foot existing tenant space located at
323 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suite E.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-010 approving Conditional Use Permit 18-015 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
10B
10C. Conditional Use Permit 18-013
Fun Fish Games, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish an amusement arcade use within a 650 square foot existing tenant space located at
38418 10th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-013 to approve Conditional Use Permit 18-013 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
10C
10D. Palmdale Civic Center Complete Streets Project
City of Palmdale, Applicant
The proposed project consists of creating a "Complete Streets" project that includes: bulb-out crossings, bike
lanes, cycle tracks (Class IV Separated Bikeways) and/or buffered bike lanes, mini-roundabouts, street lights,
and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)-compliant curb ramps.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-008, approving the Palmdale Civic Center Complete Streets Project and adopt the Initial Study with Mitigated Negative Declaration, finding that the project would not have potentially significant impacts with the incorporation of mitigation measures, and find that the project and acquisition of right-of-way is consistent with applicable goals, objectives, and policies of the City of Palmdale General Plan. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
10D
10E. Avenue S-8 and 40th Street East Roundabout Project (Project No. 741)
City of Palmdale, Applicant
The City of Palmdale, in cooperation with the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans), is proposing
to construct a roundabout at the intersection of Avenue S-8 and 40th Street East in the City of Palmdale, Los
Angeles County, California (see Figures 1, 2, and 3).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-002, approving the Avenue S-8 and 40th Street East Roundabout Project and adopt the Initial Study with Mitigated Negative Declaration, find that the project would not have potentially significant impacts with the incorporation of mitigation measures, and find that the project and acquisition of right-of-way is consistent with the applicable goals, objectives, and policies of the City of Palmdale General Plan. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
10E
10F. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 19-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend various sections of Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) Title 16 Subdivisions and Title 17
Zoning (Zoning Code) to streamline how the code is used, clarify and eliminate ambiguity, and to ensure
consistency with State law, the PMC and the General Plan.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-011 recommending that the City Council approve ZOA 19-001 and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
10F
11. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
12. Planning Commission Communications
13. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, April 11, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City
of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
